composition.rule: Load P1342 binding R3 by exact SHA-256, load its exact R2 predecessor by the hash declared above, require the R2 closed schema and all 19 hooks rows byte-for-byte, apply all 19 R3 row_overlay records by identical zero-based row_index and hook, then join exactly one row_capsule_bindings record by the same row_index and hook. Missing, extra, reordered, duplicated or mismatched rows, aliases, capsules or fields are Violated. No P1342 row field, event schema, carrier rule, Location/snapshot rule, receipt rule, attempt-kind/R rule, cardinality, B01-B05 closure or Unknown precedence is replaced. Only R3 allowed-diff-boundary inference is replaced by the deterministic capsule normalization in the P1343 contract.

capsule_manifest_contract.encoding: UTF-8 with LF only for source, base64-of-exact-utf8-bytes for replacement
capsule_manifest_contract.closed_world: All top-level and nested keys must equal closed_metadata exactly. Each of the ten file paths, whole-file hashes, ordered capsule-id lists, 36 capsule records, 18 hook aliases, replacement bytes/hashes/lengths, two anchors/hashes/cardinalities, kind, cfg, symbol, covers and candidate_body_rule are normative exactly as serialized in the protected capsule baseline. Unknown keys, values or aliases are Violated.
capsule_manifest_contract.cryptographic_validation: Decode every replacement with strict canonical base64, require decoded UTF-8 bytes, exact byte_len and lowercase SHA-256. Rehash every anchor text as UTF-8, require its declared lowercase SHA-256 and cardinality 1 in the pinned baseline file. Rehash each full candidate-free file and require the file record digest. For all 36 records require anchor_before || decoded replacement || anchor_after exactly once in that file.
capsule_manifest_contract.identity_validation: Capsule IDs and file paths are exact case-sensitive strings. IDs are unique globally; each appears exactly once in exactly one file.capsule_ids list and one capsules record. Paths are exact allowlisted repository-relative POSIX paths with no dot segment, absolute form, symlink traversal or duplicate canonical target.
capsule_manifest_contract.coverage_validation: The union of row_capsule_bindings capsule_ids plus facade_binding must equal all 36 IDs. For every productive capsule, the row hooks joined through hook_aliases must equal its capsule-baseline covers set exactly; test-facade is not a row. Empty, omitted, invented or extra coverage is Violated.

forbidden_bindings: Use SequenceMatcher, edit distance, heuristic hunk alignment, line-number union or candidate-declared byte ranges to establish the allowed diff.
Compare a live candidate file hash directly to the candidate-free whole-file hash before inverse normalization.

Trust marker, path, range, hash, cfg, symbol, anchor, writer, projection, reachability, cardinality or verdict asserted by DTO, facade or candidate evidence without deriving it from pinned bytes and runtime evidence.
Recognize marker-looking text in strings, raw strings, chars, block comments, non-full-line comments or reconstructed macro output.
Accept missing, extra, duplicate, nested, overlapping, mismatched or non-allowlisted capsules, or a capsule outside its exact Rust owner symbol and branch.
Accept an insert node not dominated by its exact required cfg, or a replace capsule whose normal branch does not contain the exact candidate-free replacement payload.
Accept bytes outside capsule regions, false replacement bytes, changed anchors, altered normal semantics, cfg(test) decoys, dead branches or fixture-unreached bindings.
Accept more than one raw-ledger append writer, any post-hoc raw construction, any projection write or runtime coverage without matching source row and capsule records.
Drop, weaken or reinterpret any composed P1342 event, carrier, Location, snapshot, receipt, attempt-kind/R, ordering, identity, challenge, typed-value, span, B01-B05 or Unknown obligation.
Treat deterministic normalization as sufficient for productive origin, runtime coverage or functional equivalence.
